hypothesis: The L2 capability gate is now fixed (declared=2), exposing a real missing connection: the branch predictor's resolve/update path is not wired. Symptom is bench_branch_predict64 seeing 0 resolutions (expected >=128) and predictor_training finding no branch-resolution evidence, plus branches=0/mispredicts=0 in the perf line. The mechanism: the EX resolve of a conditional branch / JAL / JALR does not drive dbg_bp_resolve/dbg_bp_mispredict (they appear tied low) and does not assert branch_predictor.update_valid with update_pc/update_target/update_is_branch/update_is_jal/update_is_jalr/update_taken. Consequently the predictor never trains (BTB stays all-invalid, BHT stuck at 01), every prediction falls back to PC+4, and the two debug observation ports never pulse, so all resolution-count checks read 0.
constraints: Keep the frozen top-level port list of rv32i5 unchanged (names, widths, directions).
dbg_features must remain the constant 3'b011, valid from time 0, never dynamically driven or faked.
Only control transfers that actually reach resolve and are not killed by an older mispredict may pulse dbg_bp_resolve/dbg_bp_mispredict; don't count squashed younger control transfers.
BTB/BHT same-cycle priority: produce this cycle prediction from the OLD entry first, then apply this cycle resolve update; a write must not alter the already-issued prediction.
BTB allocation: conditional branch only on BTB-miss-and-taken; not-taken never allocates; JAL/JALR allocate/update on first resolve or target change; JAL/JALR must not update BHT.
BHT is 16x2-bit saturating, index PC[5:2], reset 01, update every resolved conditional branch by actual direction.
Squashed younger control transfers must not write BTB/BHT; correctly predicted taken branches must NOT trigger an extra flush and still update BHT.
Preserve L1 base pipeline: PC priority reset > redirect > ECALL halt freeze > load-use stall > PC+4; load-use holds one cycle with bubble; keep I/D cache behavior intact.
Synchronous active-low reset; every registered output (including dmem_valid) 0 during reset.
verification_targets: predictor_training: branch-resolution evidence present; after warm-up >= 64 resolved control transfers, mispredicts <= 8, retired instructions == 132.
dbg_bp_resolve pulses on every committed control transfer that reaches resolve; dbg_bp_mispredict pulses exactly on direction or target mismatch.
capability level stays declared=2/expected=2 (features=3'b011) with regression suite still passing.
Correctly predicted taken branches do not cause a spurious second flush (perf line should show nonzero, bounded mispredicts, not zero).
rejected_hypotheses: Previous hypothesis that dbg_features was hardwired to L1 3'b001 was applied and is now resolved (capability reads declared=2), so it is not the current root cause.
A pure caches/timing regression is rejected: the ooo_overlap64 run halts correctly with exit_code=0x820 and all its checks pass; the failure is isolated to the branch-predictor resolve/counting path.
